_om: Engelsk översättning av foremal.json. Bara texter; siffrorna står i den svenska filen. Föremålen kopplas ihop med sina id:n. namn sätts in med liten första bokstav mitt i meningar, kort är formen i listor och korta rader.

lista.beskrivning: If you fall into the cellar vaults, you climb straight back up.
verkar: The floor gives way, but the hook catches on the edge. You hang from the rope a while and haul yourself up again. The rope stays down there.

lista.beskrivning: The next trap does not strike. Its scales are loose, as if they once sat on something far larger.
verkar: The amulet grows warm against your chest just as {falla} strikes, but not at you. When you look, the amulet has cracked.

lista.beskrivning: Your lantern withstands one darkness. The flame would burn twice as bright against something that shines.
verkar: The lantern goes out, but you have another wick. With trembling fingers you get it lit again.

lista.beskrivning: Defence +1: you are harder to hit. Breaks after three hits from creatures.
verkar: The blow catches the rim of the shield and leaves a new dent.
slut: The shield cracks and falls to pieces.

lista.namn: The bag with a false bottom
lista.hittad: the bag with a false bottom
lista.beskrivning: Half of what you lose when the serpent wakes, or when someone snatches gold, is hidden in the false bottom.
verkar: The false bottom holds. {antal} gold is still there.

lista.beskrivning: The needle points to the nearest gate.
If you flee a fight, the creature has no time to strike.
verkar: You dash the powder at the floor as you turn. The room fills with grey smoke, and you are gone to the {riktning} before anything can react.

lista.beskrivning: When you enter a new room, the shard shows one of the rooms beyond its doors. Three times.
verkar: The shard in your bag catches something in the doorway to the {riktning}.
slut: The shard turns dull, as if something has breathed on it.

lista.beskrivning: If a creature appears, you throw the knife first.
verkar: You throw the knife before {varelse} is on you.

lista.beskrivning: A curved horn of bone. You hear whether something is breathing in the rooms next door, and sounds two rooms away that others only hear through one wall.
If you draw a card that wakes the serpent, you may draw again, once. The notes sound thin, as if they lacked a horn.
verkar: The serpent stirs, and you play three low notes on the flute. The breathing slows again. The flute cracks. You reach for another handful.

lista.beskrivning: When the sun goes down it turns by itself, and the gate waits one more round for you.
verkar: The sun goes down, and the hourglass turns over in your bag. For you the sand stands still: the gate waits one more round.

lista.beskrivning: Large as a dove's egg and worth 40 gold when you get out.
forbannelse: The pearl turns cold in your bag as you reach for the gold. The breathing around you quickens. Every handful wakes the serpent a little more while you carry it.

lista.beskrivning: A heavy gold coin with a hole in the middle, just wide enough for a rope. Worth 25 gold when you get out.
forbannelse: The creature sniffs at your bag. The coin has a smell, and everything in the tower with teeth knows where you are.

lista.beskrivning: A small crown that someone has dropped, with an empty setting the size of a dove's egg. Worth 30 gold when you get out.
forbannelse: The crown begins to glow faintly through your bag. Whoever stands in the next room sees the light.

lista.beskrivning: Strength +1: you hit more easily in a fight.
Defence +2: you are harder to hit. It is heavy, so if you flee a fight the blow at your back always lands.

lista.namn: The sword with the red hilt
lista.hittad: a sword with a red hilt
lista.kort: the sword with the red hilt
lista.beskrivning: A thin sword, light in the hand. Strength +2. Worth 15 gold when you get out.
forbannelse: The sword tugs at your hand when you do not strike. It wants blood, and if it gets nothing else it takes yours.

lista.hittad: a shed skin, dry and translucent
lista.beskrivning: Dry and translucent, as large as a folded sail. Worth 30 gold when you get out.
forbannelse: The serpent smells its own skin. The breathing quickens when you reach for the gold, and sometimes it wakes because of it.

lista.beskrivning: From someone who was here before.

lista.hittad: a green stone, glossy as an eye
lista.beskrivning: A green stone, glossy as an eye. It pulls towards the treasure chamber. The lower the sun, the more it feels as if it looks back.
vander: The stone turns cold in your hand, and the pupil in it turns towards you. Something sees through it now. Every handful from the chamber wakes the serpent a little more while you carry the stone.

lista.beskrivning: An egg, warm and heavy, with a shell like scales. Worth 50 gold when you get out. It grows warmer every round.
vander: The egg cracks in your bag. Something wet and pale crawls out, turns towards you and hisses.

lista.hittad: a black knife with notches in the hilt
lista.beskrivning: A black knife with three empty notches in its hilt. It grows stronger for every life it takes, but it smells of everything it has taken.
vander: The knife grows warm, and a notch in the hilt fills with something dark. Strength +1 for every life it takes, at most three. But the creatures smell the blood and attack more often.

lista.beskrivning: A glow-worm in a lidded jar. Darkness has no hold on you, and you see what moves in the rooms next door. It grows and shines brighter every round.
vander: The glow-worm has grown to fill the jar. Its light shines through your bag, and whoever stands in the next room sees you.

lista.beskrivning: The holed coin, threaded on the rope. It pulls towards the nearest gold lying on a floor in the tower. Worth 25 gold when you get out.
fogas: You thread the coin on the rope and tie it fast. When you hold it up it begins to swing, and it does not swing straight.

lista.beskrivning: The mirror shard behind the spare wick. Your lantern does not go out while you carry it, and when you enter a new room the shard shows two of the rooms beyond its doors. Three times.
verkar: The shard throws the lantern's glow through the doorway to the {riktning}.
slut: The wick burns down, and the shard turns sooty and dull.
fogas: You wedge the shard behind the wick in your lantern. The light bounces off it and burns twice as bright.

lista.beskrivning: The serpent's skin, fastened with the amulet. The creatures take you for one of their own and attack half as often when you do not attack them. Worth 30 gold when you get out.
fogas: The amulet's scales fit the pattern of the skin. You wrap the skin around your shoulders and fasten it with the amulet. It smells of serpent.

lista.beskrivning: The flute, pushed into the bone horn. You hear all that the bone horn hears, and if you draw a card that wakes the serpent, you may draw again, twice.
verkar: The serpent stirs, and you blow the pipe. The note goes through the horn and fills the chamber, and the breathing slows again. You reach for another handful.
slut: The flute cracks loose from the horn. You still have the horn.
fogas: The flute fits into the narrow end of the bone horn. You blow gently, and the note turns deep and low.

lista.beskrivning: The black pearl in the empty setting of the rusted crown. Worth 100 gold when you get out, more than the two apart.
fogas: The pearl slides into the crown's empty setting with a click, as if it had been waiting there.

1: "Day two. The walls are warm, though it is raining outside. Bertil says it is the sun that has lain on them. I do not believe him."
"If you find this: do not go towards the middle until you have heard the breathing. Listen first. There is a sound beneath everything else."
2: "The floor moves when I lie still. Up and down, slowly, as when you sleep beside someone."
"I have counted. The sound comes every eighth breath, my breaths. It is not the wind."
3: "The vaults are too many and too alike. I have seen such before, in a whale that drifted ashore when I was small."
"The stair has vertebrae. I have felt them. Do not go down it in the dark."
4: "The gate is not a gate. Get out before it closes. I have no time to write more."
"I know now where we are. I know why it is warm. If you are reading this, it is already too late to be afraid. Run."

tarst_tar: The sword with the red hilt tugs at your hand and cuts you. It wanted to fight.
brynja_fly: The scale mail is heavy, and you turn too slowly.
foremal_hittar: Under a loose stone lies something: {foremal}.
Deep in a niche, wrapped in a rag: {foremal}.
foremal_full: Here lies {foremal}, but you cannot carry more than {max} things. You leave it.
foremal_ligger: Someone has left {foremal} here. You take it.
foremal_ligger_full: Here lies {foremal}, but your bag is full.
kompass_har: The compass spins. You are standing in a gate.
spegel_falla: Something on the floor there looks wrong: {falla}.
benlur_varelse: The bone horn catches breathing behind the wall to the {riktning}. Something is waiting there.
Through the bone horn you hear claws on stone to the {riktning}.
brev_tips_ristning: In the margin someone has drawn an arrow and written: the signs in the wall, to the {horn}.
brev_tips_varelse: At the very bottom, in a shaky hand: something waits to the {horn}. Do not go there unarmed.
brev_tips_kammare: On the back an arrow, and one word: the breathing. The arrow points {horn}.
brev_hittar: Under a stone lies a folded paper, damp and brittle. Someone has written in charcoal:
pendel_pekar: The pendulum pulls towards the {horn}, where gold lies on the floor.
pendel_har: The pendulum hangs straight down. There is gold here.
pendel_stilla: The pendulum hangs still. No gold lies on any floor.
ljusspegel_morker: The flame flickers, but the shard catches the light and throws it back. It does not go dark.
oga_pekar_har: The stone lies still. You are standing in the chamber.
oga_stirrar_har: The stone stares straight down into the floor.
kniv_minns_mer: Another notch in the knife's hilt fills. Strength +{kraft} with the knife.
glodmask_morker: The flame goes out, but the glow-worm in the jar keeps shining. It does not go dark.
pilgrim_forbannad: Here lies {foremal}. Something in you says no. You leave it be.
foremal_guld: What you carry in your bag is worth {antal} gold out here.
